description: Internal definitions and inline functions for managing MPU regions in ARC architecture, specifically for MPU version 6, including region size calculations, region initialization, and access checks.

methods.name: _bank_select
methods.description: Selects an MPU bank by writing to auxiliary register.

methods.name: _region_init
methods.description: Initializes an MPU region with address, size, and attributes.

methods.name: get_region_index_by_type
methods.description: Returns the region index based on the region type, considering priority and static regions.

methods.name: _is_enabled_region
methods.description: Checks if a specific MPU region is enabled.

methods.name: _is_in_region
methods.description: Checks if a memory range is within a specified MPU region.

methods.name: _is_user_accessible_region
methods.description: Checks if a region is accessible for user or kernel, based on write permission.
